Firebase database

Publish products, categories, settings and photos without changing private orders. Use full publication only when you also intend to publish local order records. Customers can browse products; only your store account can change the database or read private orders.

If online order deletion is blocked, update the Firebase rules once: · Open Firebase rules. Paste the copied rules and click Publish.

Local editing is available. Connect to load or publish your Firebase database.

This preview cannot keep your database after refresh.

Use Backup with photos before closing or refreshing, then Open database to restore that ZIP. Download and open the editor on your computer for normal local storage.

Click Publish products only to update the online catalog. Local edits and downloaded backups stay separate until published. Export website catalog is available for a static backup.
